component.name: Pedal Trinity
component.summary: Pedaliera per chitarra con 219 pedali emulati

description.p: A virtual pedalboard of up to 100 slots with a catalogue of 219 original models inspired by compact guitar pedals: overdrive, distortion, fuzz, BBD modulation, delay, reverb, pitch, dynamics, EQ, amp simulators, cabinet IRs and A/B splitters. Analog stages are emulated from their circuits. Factory and user presets, views of 3, 6, 9 or 18 pedals. VST3, LV2 and standalone.
